comment_data.body: I believe "Inpostasion de'l/de Audio" sounds better. Or keep 'inpostasion audio' too...

Medium can also be 'mezo/mes' or 'medan' (that sounds better to me).

You may find it listed in online dictionaries as: 'medhàn' (medan) or 'mexàn' (mezan) - (don't worry too much about the spelling, they only refer to the pronunciation).

comment_data.body:
In fact, 'uzo' refers to having a habit of doing something: "_łu el fa łe robe drio el uzo suo_"

Actually, the phrase relates the action to bandwidth usage. It suggests lowering the settings when bandwidth is insufficient or when the user wants to reduce consumption.

I can find a better word.
